name: Min Specs
deliverable: Ruthless reduction of operating protocols down to non-negotiable rules

steps.text: State the purpose, then list every rule and habit the group treats as required.
Split the list into musts and shoulds; test each must by what breaking it would cost.
Publish the rules that survive; cut the rest.

failure: Every rule has a defender, so the list stays long and the group leaves with a tidier bureaucracy.
intervention: Hold up one rule and ask what exactly would fail if we broke it tomorrow; cut what no one can name.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
